# gitea_team (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve details of a Gitea team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_team" "example" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `can_create_repos` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `include_all_repositories` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `organisation` (String)
- `permission` (String)
- `units` (List of String)
- `units_map` (Map of String) Map of repository units to their permissions
